items.label: Jira tasks tested during QA internship

items.description: Automated online ordering workflows for pickup, dine-in, home delivery, and gift cards using Selenium and Playwright. Built and maintained automation for Stripe and JCC Pay, and performed UI, functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing across ordering, checkout, payment, POS, loyalty, and third-party integrations. Tested approximately 20 restaurant mobile apps across Android and iOS, investigated production issues, supported onboarding and go-live validation, and contributed to 90+ Jira tasks released to production. Contributed to improved payment-flow stability, with a reported 20% reduction in transaction failures.

Performed manual, functional, regression, smoke, and integration testing across web and mobile environments. Tested approximately 30 Jira tasks covering ordering, checkout, payments, POS integrations, onboarding, and migration workflows. Tested payment gateways including Authorize.net, FreedomPay, JCC, Worldpay, CardConnect, and Stripe. Validated hosted and iframe payment flows, saved cards, delivery fees, address book, store availability, tips, checkout functionality, and V2 to V3.1 migration requirements.
